title: 云原生安全活动与 AI 驱动业务自动化
english: Two recent updates highlight complementary priorities for senior cloud-native and AI practitioners. Proaction reports that Codex, GPT-Live-1, and GPT-6 Astra help it build, operate, and sell modern fleet-management products faster, with a reported 60% increase in sales and more than 75 hours saved. Separately, CNCF announced Security Slam 2026 – Fall Edition, a 30-day virtual event running from October 5 through November 6, 2026, organized in partnership with the Open Source Security Foundation. Together, these items connect AI-assisted software and business operations with the continuing importance of open-source cloud-native security practices.
chinese: OpenAI News 的案例称，Proaction 使用 Codex、GPT-Live-1 和 GPT-6 Astra，更快地构建、运营和销售现代车队管理产品，并报告销售额提升 60%、节省超过 75 小时。CNCF 则介绍了 Security Slam 2026 秋季版，这是一个与 OpenSSF 合作的 30 天线上活动，时间为 2026 年 10 月 5 日至 11 月 6 日。两条信息分别体现了 AI 辅助业务与软件交付，以及云原生开源安全的重要性。
why_it_matters: 对云原生和 AIOps 从业者而言，AI 工具正在延伸到构建、运营和销售等环节；同时，云原生环境仍需要持续关注开源安全。对 Agent Infra 和职业发展而言，理解 AI 辅助工作流与安全工程之间的关系，有助于形成更完整的交付和运营能力。
interview_expression: I see AI-assisted development as part of a broader operational workflow that includes building, operating, and selling software. At the same time, cloud-native teams must keep open-source security as a core engineering responsibility.

vocabulary.example: The company builds modern fleet management products with AI-assisted tools.
Open-source security remains important for cloud-native infrastructure.
Security Slam 2026 is described as a 30-day virtual event.
